title: Melting Robot Bard
description: A rusty, broken robot with glowing yellow and purple eyes stands on a cracked white platform covered in musical notation. It holds a melting green candle that drips wax while musical notes, colorful icons, and swirling energy emanate from its head and body against a dark, smoky background.
prompt: A rusty broken steampunk robot with one glowing yellow eye and one purple eye stands on a cracked white platform etched with musical notation. It holds a tall melting green candle that drips wax. Colorful musical notes, icons, and swirling energy patterns float out from its head. The background transitions from smoky orange to dark teal and deep red with abstract circuit patterns. Digital painting style with strong contrast and painterly texture.
